correctness.rationale: For probability sphere S^{d−1} and single positive coordinate-maximal cell C_d, gradients G_i=e_i−x_i x and rotations K_ij=x_i e_j−x_j e_i form full orthogonal normalized vector tangent system of dimension d(d+1)/2. Signed-permutation invariance and moments s_d=E(max_i |X_i|), t_d=E(max_i|X_i|²) give a direct sum of one scalar λ0=(1−t_d)/(2(d−1)) of multiplicity 1+C(d−1,2) and d−1 identical 2×2 real symmetric blocks with a=(d−2+t_d)/(2(d−1)^2), b=(1+(d−2)t_d)/(4(d−1)), c=s_d/(2√(2(d−1))). Strict λ−<λ0<λ+ follows from identity (d−1)s_d−(dt_d−1)=E[(1−M)(dM+1)]>0 and determinant sign. Gaussian radius independence gives explicit univariate erf integrals. Normal Gaussian maximum tail estimates and variance→0 imply λ+~log(d)/(2d), λ0~1/(2d), λ−~1/(4d log d), sharp ratio ~2(log d)^2. Independently integrated moments and checked trace, eigenvalue ordering and d=2,3,4,6,100 numerical values, including d3 0.004813332/0.074778517/0.420408150; finite checks corroborate the analytical proof.
residual_risks: Asymptotics require Gaussian-maximum concentration; verifier does not independently prove this infinite-dimensional limit.

originality.rationale: The general vector Slepian framework of Plattner–Simons and Michel–Plattner–Seibert covers construction of concentration matrices but does not evaluate a single signed coordinate-dominant cubical cell in every dimension or determine three ordered blocks and Gaussian-max edge asymptotics. A closely relevant published Resultary theorem concerns the identical cubical cell but the scalar pure degree-two harmonic space and a four-branch spectrum; its same leading condition-number growth does not determine the vector tangent spectrum. Best-of-knowledge novelty of exact tangent mixed first moments and full-dimensional formula survives.
residual_risks: A general Slepian matrix construction could mechanically produce these matrices at fixed dimension, but does not supply all-d evaluated spectrum, strict ordering or exact asymptotic constant without further work.
Other unindexed vector cubed-sphere cell studies might have computed the same special case.

value.rationale: The cubical signed-coordinate cells are natural equal-measure domains from cubed-sphere geometry. The exact tangent first-order gradient/rotation spectral decomposition, strict ordering, dimension-dependent condition numbers, and sharp Gaussian-max growth provide a self-contained structural solution to observing a natural vector harmonic space; neither trivial restatement nor arbitrary small sample.
